rules.name: Device Timezone Mismatch (New York vs IP in India)
rules.description: Flags discrepancy between browser local clock timezone and public IP geolocation.

rules.name: Multiple WebRTC IP Leaks
rules.description: Detects distinct public/private IP addresses leaked via WebRTC peer connections.

rules.name: Cookies Disabled on Client
rules.description: Client browser rejects session cookies or local storage access.

rules.name: Missing Standard Browser Headers
rules.description: Detects absence of standard headers such as Accept-Language or Accept-Encoding.

rules.name: Mobile Device Emulated on PC (iPhone / Android)
rules.description: Detects mobile user agents running on x86_64 desktop architecture.

rules.name: Jailbroken iOS Device
rules.description: Cydia or jailbreak substrate files detected on iOS runtime.

rules.name: Rooted Android Device
rules.description: Root access binaries or su paths detected on Android OS.

rules.name: Unusual Screen Size (1111x333)
rules.description: Flags non-standard display viewports or zero-dimensional frames.

rules.name: Unpopular or Unknown User-Agent
rules.description: Flags unrecognizable, empty, or unparseable user-agent strings.

rules.name: Anti-Detect Browser (Patched Canvas + Fake Hardware)
rules.description: Detects custom browser patches randomizing canvas hashing or hardware concurrency.

rules.name: Privacy Browser Profile
rules.description: Detects hardened privacy configurations blocking device fingerprints.

rules.name: Suspicious Browser Profile - Bots or Postman
rules.description: Detects API testing clients (Postman, cURL, Requests) or bot scripts.

rules.name: Privacy Extension Interference
rules.description: Detects anti-tracking extensions altering standard JS DOM attributes.

rules.name: Suspicious Browser Profile - Medium Risk
rules.description: Minor request header inconsistencies detected.

rules.name: Suspicious Browser Profile - High Risk
rules.description: Multiple anomalies detected across client headers and rendering attributes.

rules.name: Browser Version Age Between 1-2 Years
rules.description: Flags moderately old browser releases.

rules.name: Browser Version Age Between 2-5 Years
rules.description: Flags outdated browser versions.

rules.name: Outdated Browser Version (Chrome 80 / 2020)
rules.description: Flags legacy browser versions older than 5 years.

rules.name: User-Agent vs Platform Spoofing (Mac Safari on Windows)
rules.description: Discrepancy between User-Agent OS claim and JS navigator.platform.

rules.name: Device Shared Across Multiple Users (6+ Accounts)
rules.description: Excessive account velocity associated with a single hardware identifier.

rules.name: Dynamic Component Canvas Blocked
rules.description: Client script failed to obtain valid Canvas/WebGL render fingerprint.

rules.name: Commercial Proxy / VPN Connection
rules.description: IP address identified as a datacenter, VPN, or proxy exit node.

rules.name: Clicks Fired from JavaScript (Fake Events)
rules.description: Detects synthetic mouse clicks or programmatic form submissions (isTrusted == false).

rules.name: Screen Mirrored to Display
rules.description: Active external screen broadcasting session.

rules.name: Remote Desktop Software Used
rules.description: Session running inside active remote desktop interface (AnyDesk, RDP).

rules.name: Screen Captured During Transaction
rules.description: Active screen recording detected on mobile device.

rules.name: Phone Call Active During Transaction
rules.description: Mobile voice call active during checkout execution.

rules.name: Device Tethered via USB Debugging
rules.description: Developer USB debugging bridge connected to mobile device.

rules.name: Plain Headless Chrome Execution
rules.description: Unmasked headless Chrome browser detected (navigator.webdriver == true).

rules.name: Headless Automation Flag Hidden + Zero Mouse Movement
rules.description: Automation flag spoofed but telemetry records zero cursor movement.

rules.name: Tor Anonymizing Exit Node
rules.description: Traffic originates from a known Tor onion router exit node.
